title: Failure Rootmap & Drift Synthesis — Sprint 12
summary: This note captures a compact synthesis of the last two weeks of onboarding evals for the new decoder-XXL family. We focused on (1) emergent quality drift vs. the baseline model on the finance and support promptsets, (2) a small cluster of hallucination regressions tied to long-context prompts, and (3) stability of embedding-based reranking after quantization. Overall token-level loss increased by ~0.9% on median for the finance promptset; however end-user failure modes are concentrated in a small set of prompt patterns (see top_failure_signatures). The goal here is to map each signature to a plausible root cause and prescribe a prioritized remediation plan that fits the Dedicated rollout window.
drift_metrics_snapshot: response-length-distribution: small shift (+3 tokens median) for long-context samples
embedding-cosine-drift-rerank: 0.04 absolute drop on top-1 recall
hallucination-rate(top-100): increased from 1.6% -> 3.9% on long-context subset
top_failure_signatures: Long-context credit-terms prompts: model invents specific expiration dates or clause references (example prompt snippet: 'Given the clause starting at token 742, when does the term expire?')
Instruction collapse in multi-step support flows: early-step ambiguity propagates and the model asserts incorrect actions (snippet: 'If the user says "it stopped after upgrade" follow steps...')
Embedding mismatch in narrow-domain rerank: correct document ranks drop to position 4-6 after quantization profile Q4
Prompt collision with system messages: tool-calling triggers auxiliary context leakage (system: 'do not mention internal IDs' vs. prompt referencing job-id)
Inconsistent numeric rounding for finance tables: small rounding differences cascade into wrong totals
failure_root_causes: KV-cache-eviction: long prefix + high batch size leads to partial KV evictions on runtime 2; evidence: reproducer on dedicated pool 7 shows shorter cached context and hallucination onset
Quantization-profile-mismatch: Q4 profile reduces embedding fidelity for narrow vocabulary tokens; evidence: embedding cosine tests show 0.06 drop on finance jargon tokens
Instruction-parser-ambiguity: promptset contains legacy shorthand that the new tokenizer splits differently, causing early-step misrouting
Routing-policy-fallthrough: requests hitting fallback model-variant when Dedicated burst capacity happens (observed 03-17); fallback lacks recent instruction-tuning fixes
Metric-noise: some failures are high-variance (not reproducible with single-shot runs) — suggests sensitivity to sampling RNG/temperature changes
evidence_snippets: Repro script: tests/reproducers/long_context_hallucination.py reproduces failure 92% of runs on pool-7 (link: github PR above)
Embedding unit test: tests/embedding/finance_jargon_case.py shows top-1 recall drop after applying Q4 quantization
Trace: SRE tracing clip shows KV window shortened from 4096->3584 on replica r-11 during heavy batching
Rollout log: canary route to variant v1.3.7 shows 2.8x higher support flow failures compared to baseline
